dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many expert details (hosting‑mode immutability, auto‑scaling target‑tracking config, instance‑selection matrix, heuristic for TargetValue) that go beyond basic docs, but some sections merely restate AWS documentation without novel thresholds or decision trees, e.g., no concrete rule for when to prefer serverless vs real‑time beyond a latency table.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Offers a clear AWS‑specific 10‑step provisioning workflow with exact CLI ordering (model → config → endpoint → scaling → capture → monitor → A/B → shadow → JumpStart). Missing a brief rollback/cleanup procedure and a dedicated validation step for input parameters, which keeps it from perfect.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides a concrete NEVER list with specific reasons (single‑instance production, missing auto‑scaling, 100% data capture latency, mixed instance types in A/B, in‑place mode switch). Missing a few common pitfalls (e.g., forgetting VPC endpoints for private models, omitting KMS encryption) and the list is limited to five items, so two points are deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter is complete, description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and includes a rich keyword list and activation triggers. The output format contract is explicitly defined, meeting all specification requirements.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Uses sections, quick‑reference tables, and a navigation matrix to layer information, but the document is dense and some critical rules (e.g., the NEVER list) are buried deep, causing potential cognitive overload for an agent scanning quickly.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates freedom well: destructive actions (create‑model, create‑endpoint) require explicit input values and a checklist before execution. Lacks an explicit "dry‑run" or confirmation prompt, which would tighten safety for irreversible provisioning.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Quick navigation → Detailed sections → Output contract), aiding comprehension, but the overall structure mixes ad‑hoc headings with the formal pattern, preventing a fully canonical layout.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI snippets, decision trees, and a ready‑to‑use checklist template, enabling an agent to execute the plan. Missing handling for error cases (CLI failures, missing VPC config), no guidance for updating an existing endpoint, and limited edge‑case coverage, which reduces robustness.
